chunks: Abu al-Qasim al-Hasan b. Muhammad al-Sakuni narrated to us. He said: al-Hadrami narrated to us. He said: Yahya al-Himmani narrated to us. He said: Abu Awana narrated to us from Abu Balj from Amr b. Maymun from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
'Ali is the master (wali) of every believer after me.'

key_terms.بعدي: After me — indicating succession and continuity of authority
key_terms.مؤمن: Believer — one who has faith in Allah and His messengers
key_terms.ولي: Wali — master, guardian, authority figure; central term in the Imamate doctrine

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali's authority over believers according to Ibn Abbas?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) explicitly declares that Ali b. Abi Talib is the wali (master/guardian) of every believer after him. This hadith is one of the most widely transmitted in both Sunni and Shi'i sources, narrated here through Ibn Abbas. It establishes Ali's special authority and leadership role in the Muslim community following the Prophet's departure.
